verdict.rationale: Reclaim explicitly markets 'Smart Meetings' as finding the best time to meet across all attendees' schedules, with automatic rescheduling to the next best time if a higher-priority event overbooks a lower-priority one, indicating continuous optimization rather than picking the first free slot. Community evidence corroborates dynamic re-planning behavior (habits/priority throttling, automatic reshuffling) though one user reports the invite-detection flow not working as expected. missing for 10: independent benchmark or third-party verification of multi-attendee optimization quality, and detail on how conflicting priorities across many attendees are resolved.
